ai_summary: This document outlines the outcomes of Aartech Solonics' board meeting, including the approval of a modest final dividend of Re. 0.125 per equity share for FY 2025-26 and the scheduling of the 44th Annual General Meeting. A significant red flag emerges from the familial control, as the Chairman & Managing Director and CEO (whose remunerations were revised) are siblings, and their father is a Non-Executive Director whose re-appointment was also approved, raising concerns about independent corporate governance and oversight of executive compensation.
